title: Thermodynamic Invariants of Coupled Channels: A Many-Channel Tolman-Ehrenfest Effect
summary: When multiple thermodynamic channels are coupled, single-channel equilibrium conditions fail. Extending the Tolman--Ehrenfest effect to the entropy manifold, we derive the unique $n$-channel invariant $\zeta_i T_i = C$, where $\zeta_i$ is the holonomy of the Ruppeiner connection. For the granular volume--stress ensemble, Rowe's dilatancy ratio and energy restriction emerge as geometric consequences of the off-diagonal curvature $g_{V\sigma}$, and the 60-year puzzle of state-dependent $K_\mu$ is resolved: the correction $\zeta_V$ reaches $O(1)$ near jamming. The prediction $\zeta_V\chi=\mathrm{const}$ across a shear band is experimentally testable.

AI.tldr: 多热力学通道耦合时单通道平衡条件失效，通过推广Tolman-Ehrenfest效应到熵流形，推导出n通道不变量ζ_i T_i = C，并用于解释颗粒材料的剪胀比和能量约束，解决了状态相关K_μ之谜，预言跨剪切带的ζ_Vχ为常数。
AI.motivation: 多热力学通道耦合时，单通道平衡条件失效，需要建立新的平衡描述。
AI.method: 将Tolman-Ehrenfest效应推广至熵流形，利用Ruppeiner几何的完整性和曲率，推导出n通道不变量的表达式。
AI.result: 得到n通道不变量ζ_i T_i = C，并显示Rowe的剪胀比和能量约束是几何曲率g_{Vσ}的自然结果，且状态相关K_μ的修正ζ_V在堵塞时达O(1)。
AI.conclusion: 预言ζ_Vχ跨剪切带为常数，该预测可通过实验验证，为理解颗粒材料提供新视角。

title: Spectral separation of variables from equivalent Lagrangian systems
summary: We investigate the dynamical equivalence of quadratic Lagrangians and its relation to separation of variables. We show that requiring two quadratic Lagrangians to generate the same Euler--Lagrange equations imposes a compatibility condition between the kinetic matrices and the potential. For constant symmetric kinetic matrices, this condition reduces to a commutation relation with the Hessian of the potential, yielding an orthogonal spectral decomposition of the configuration space. The equations of motion then decouple into independent subsystems: generically in block-separated form, and completely when the spectrum is simple. Applications include the Sawada--Kotera system and an $n$-dimensional extension of the H\'{e}non--Heiles model, where the classical integrable parameter regimes are recovered.

AI.tldr: 研究了二次拉格朗日量的动力学等价性导致运动方程解耦的条件，并通过谱分解实现变量分离。
AI.motivation: 探索二次拉格朗日量的动力学等价性与变量分离之间的关系。
AI.method: 通过要求两个二次拉格朗日量生成相同欧拉-拉格朗日方程，推导出动能矩阵与势能Hessian矩阵的对易关系，并利用正交谱分解。
AI.result: 运动方程解耦为独立子系统，通常为块分离形式，谱简单时完全分离。
AI.conclusion: 该方法应用于Sawada-Kotera系统和n维Henon-Heiles模型，恢复了经典可积参数区域。

title: Epstein vector zeta functions related to the ADE Lie algebras
summary: We introduce a vector-valued generalization of the Epstein zeta functions associated with the root lattices of ADE-type Lie algebras. The quadratic forms defining these lattices correspond to the Gram matrices of the simple roots. Using the discriminant group D = P/Q, we construct vector-valued theta series that realize the Weil representation of the metaplectic group Mp(2,Z). The proposed Epstein vector zeta functions are obtained as the Mellin transform of these theta series. By exploiting the equivariance properties of the theta vectors, we derive a matrix functional equation of the Riemann type. We show that the existence of this functional equation is governed by a selection rule: it holds specifically for the subspace of C-invariant vectors, where C is the central element of Mp(2,Z). Finally, we provide a complete classification of the lattices and invariant subspaces for which this matrix functional equation is satisfied.

AI.tldr: 将Epstein zeta函数推广到ADE型李代数根格的向量值形式，构造theta级数并导出矩阵函数方程，分类了满足方程的格与不变子空间。
AI.motivation: 将Epstein zeta函数推广到向量值形式以研究ADE型根格的解析性质。
AI.method: 利用判别群D=P/Q构造向量值theta级数实现Weil表示，通过Mellin变换得到向量zeta函数，利用等变性推导矩阵函数方程。
AI.result: 导出了Riemann型矩阵函数方程，该方程仅在C-不变向量子空间上成立，并完成了满足条件的格与子空间的分类。
AI.conclusion: 向量值Epstein zeta函数在C-不变子空间上满足矩阵函数方程，且所有相关格已被分类。

title: Intrinsic-dimension empirical Bernstein inequalities for bounded self-adjoint operators
summary: Operator-valued concentration inequalities are foundational to the analysis of modern high-dimensional statistics and randomized algorithms. However, standard oracle bounds are frequently limited in practice: they require explicit a priori knowledge of the true variance, and often explicitly scale with the ambient dimension, rendering them vacuous for infinite-dimensional or heavily structured operators. Motivated by these challenges, we establish the first empirical Bennett and Bernstein inequalities for sums of independent, bounded, compact self-adjoint operators. Our fully data-driven bounds replace the unknown variance with an empirical estimate and rely strictly on the intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension. This structural shift yields computable, dimension-free guarantees that are strictly sharper for non-isotropic random matrices and seamlessly extend to infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces. We demonstrate that our empirical bounds achieve asymptotic sharpness with the best known oracle rates. Finally, as an independent byproduct, we derive novel empirical concentration guarantees for the intrinsic dimension itself.

AI.tldr: 提出了首个经验Bennett和Bernstein不等式，用于有界紧自伴算子之和，以数据驱动方式替代未知方差，仅依赖内在维度，获得无维度、可计算的界限，并在非各向同性随机矩阵和无限维希尔伯特空间中更优，且达到渐近最优性。
AI.motivation: 标准算子值浓度不等式需要先验已知方差，且随环境维度增长，对于高维或无限维算子无效，因此需要无需先验知识、维度自由的界限。
AI.method: 基于独立有界紧自伴算子之和，用经验方差估计替代未知方差，并利用内在维度替代环境维度推导经验Bennett和Bernstein不等式。
AI.result: 得到完全数据驱动的、无环境维度的浓度界限，对于非各向同性随机矩阵更锐利，且可扩展到无限维，并达到了与已知最优oracle界限相同的渐近精度。同时，作为副产品，给出了内在维度本身的经验浓度保证。
AI.conclusion: 这些经验不等式提供了一种实用的、维度自由的工具，可广泛用于高维统计和随机算法分析。

title: Bounds on the Number of Modes of a Gaussian Mixture Density
summary: We derive explicit upper bounds for the number of nondegenerate critical points of a $k$-component Gaussian mixture density in $\mathbb{R}^d$, and the number of modes when the modal set is finite, together with lower bounds. By normalizing the critical-point equations by a reference component, for $k\ge2$ we get the direct Pfaffian bound \[ U_{\mathrm{het}}(d,k)=2^{\,d+\binom{k-1}{2}}\left(d+2\min(d,k-1)+1\right)^{k-1}. \] For the same parameter range, an exact elimination augmented by an algebraic reciprocal variable gives the alternative bound \[ U_{\mathrm{aug}}(d,k)= 2^{\binom{k-1}{2}}(d+1)\left((2k-1)d+2k-1\right)^{k-1}. \] Thus, for $k\ge2$, the best critical-point bound is their minimum. A Morse-theoretic argument improves the corresponding finite-mode upper bound to \[ \left\lfloor \frac{\min\{U_{\mathrm{het}}(d,k),U_{\mathrm{aug}}(d,k)\}+1}{2}\right\rfloor. \] In the homoscedastic case, for $k\ge2$, the direct bound improves to \[ U_{\mathrm{hom}}(d,k)=2^{\,d+\binom{k-1}{2}}\left(d+\min(d,k-1)+1\right)^{k-1}, \] an affine-rank reduction replaces $d$ by the affine rank of the component means, and an augmented homoscedastic reduction gives the dimension-free bound \[ U_{\mathrm{aug,hom}}(k)=2^{\binom{k-1}{2}+1}(2k)^{k-1}. \] On the lower-bound side, for $d,k\ge 2$ we obtain \[ L_{\mathrm{bin}}(d,k)=k+\max_{2\le r\le \min(d,k)}\binom{k}{r}, \] together with a padding-product family that in particular implies the linear lower bound $d+k-1$, and a seed-closure principle that packages product and padding constructions. We further give explicit bounds for the number of connected components of the critical set.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了高斯混合密度中非退化临界点及模态数量的显式上下界，并给出了多种情况下的改进。
AI.motivation: 为理解高斯混合模型的基本结构，需要知道临界点（尤其是模态）的最大可能数量。
AI.method: 通过归一化临界点方程、Pfaffian方法、代数互反变量、Morse理论、同方差约简、组合构造、填充乘积和种子闭包原理。
AI.result: 对于k≥2，得到上界U_het、U_aug及其最小值，Morse改进，同方差下U_hom和U_aug,hom；下界L_bin及线性下界d+k-1。
AI.conclusion: 给出了高斯混合密度临界点数量的紧确界限，有助于理解其几何性质。

title: Goodness-of-Fit Testing for Point Processes in Large Populations
summary: Suppose we have an observed path from a point process counting event occurrences in a large population. Based on the observed path, we would like to test the null hypothesis that the conditional intensity of the point process belongs to a particular parametric family. We propose a novel approach to conducting such goodness-of-fit tests. The idea is to construct a unitary transformation of a natural parametric testing process such that it converges weakly to a ``standard'' target process, independent of the particular parametric form assumed under the null hypothesis. This transformation therefore paves the way for asymptotically distribution-free goodness-of-fit testing of parametric point processes. We demonstrate the good finite-sample performance of our approach through Monte Carlo simulations of Aalen-type survival processes, without and with censoring, mixture cure models, and software reliability models, and we illustrate its applicability with observed human lifetimes as well as real software failures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于酉变换的拟合优度检验方法，用于检验点过程的条件强度是否属于特定参数族，实现渐近分布无关性。
AI.motivation: 现有检验方法依赖特定参数形式，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 构造自然参数检验过程的酉变换，使其弱收敛于标准目标过程。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛模拟显示方法在多种生存模型和软件可靠性模型中具有良好的有限样本性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为参数点过程的分布无关拟合优度检验提供了有效途径。

title: Edge-indexed network time series with graph Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics
summary: We introduce a class of L\'evy-driven graph Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (grOU) models for edge-indexed network time series. The proposed framework extends generalized network autoregressive (GNAR) processes for edge-indexed network time series to continuous time and adapts graph Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics, originally developed for node-indexed processes, to the edge-indexed setting. The model accommodates general L\'evy noise and therefore captures both Brownian and jump behavior. We show that the model parameters can be estimated via a maximum-likelihood framework and derive the asymptotic properties of the estimator. We examine the finite-sample performance of the methodology through simulation studies and illustrate its practical relevance in an empirical application to high-frequency financial data. The results indicate that grOU models for edge-indexed network time series improve forecasting accuracy and reduce computational time relative to standard benchmarks while maintaining robustness through their network-based parametrization.

AI.tldr: 提出一类Lévy驱动的图Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (grOU)模型，用于边索引网络时间序列，扩展了广义网络自回归过程到连续时间，并处理边索引数据。
AI.motivation: 将广义网络自回归过程扩展至连续时间，并适应边索引设置，同时引入Lévy噪声以同时捕捉布朗运动和跳跃行为。
AI.method: 通过最大似然估计框架估计模型参数，并推导估计量的渐近性质。
AI.result: 模拟研究验证了有限样本性能，高频金融数据实证表明grOU模型相比标准基准提高了预测精度并减少了计算时间，同时保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: grOU模型有效提升了边索引网络时间序列的预测性能与计算效率，网络化参数化提供了鲁棒性。

title: Node-private community estimation in stochastic block models: Tractable algorithms and lower bounds
summary: We study the classical problem of community recovery in stochastic block models with a fixed number of communities, with a twist: We seek algorithms that are stable with respect to node-wise changes in the graph structure, formally defined as a differential privacy constraint. The algorithms we develop are based on spectral clustering, where we introduce privacy to the community recovery pipeline in the form of directly privatizing the adjacency matrix; private PCA; private convex optimization; private low-rank matrix estimation; and private approximate subspace estimation. Straightforward applications of existing private algorithms lead to a rapid increase in the privacy parameter $\epsilon$ in order to ensure consistent estimation under node differential privacy, in contrast with the simpler setting of edge privacy. To alleviate these issues, we develop novel algorithms based on (1) sampling from an exponential mechanism with a Lipschitz extension and (2) a general framework for constructing smooth projections from the space of undirected graphs to the space of bounded-degree graphs, which can then be combined with various edge-private algorithms. Importantly, the methods we develop are all computable in polynomial-time as a function of the number of nodes in the graph. We also develop novel lower bounds on the growth rate of $\epsilon$ required in order to achieve consistent community estimation under node privacy. On a technical note, our paper highlights the complications that arise when analyzing private algorithms under the non-standard scaling $\epsilon \rightarrow \infty$ and proposes some solutions. We also provide a novel application of the HGR maximal correlation from information theory in the context of accuracy amplification in PAC learning, which may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 研究节点差分隐私下随机块模型的社区恢复问题，提出多项式时间算法并推导隐私参数增长率的下界。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在节点差分隐私下需快速增大隐私参数ε才能保证一致估计，需要新算法缓解该问题。
AI.method: 基于谱聚类，采用两种新方法：1) 指数机制与Lipschitz扩展采样；2) 构建从无向图到有界度图的平滑投影以结合边私有算法。
AI.result: 算法在节点数多项式时间内可计算，并给出了ε增长率的下界。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能在节点差分隐私下实现社区恢复，且分析了非标准缩放ε→∞时的隐私分析，HGR最大相关可用于PAC学习中的精度放大。

title: Nearest-Neighbour Matching on Unbounded Supports and Covariate Shift Transfer
summary: Expectations of multivariate functions with missing labels occur in various fields such as transfer learning and average treatment effects. Although non-parametric estimators based on nearest-neighbour matching are frequently used in this context, the existing literature assumes that the covariates live in some well-shaped compact subset of $\R^d$, with densities that are bounded away from zero. In this paper, we show that the usual rates of convergence can be achieved with minimal assumptions on the covariate supports. These assumptions are replaced with conditions on the source and target distributions, among which a measure of the tranferability between the two probability measures. We show that these conditions are general, can be applied to distributions supported on manifolds, and allow the target distribution to have a heavier tail than the source distribution. We also show that this control of the transferability is needed for any estimator to achieve good rates of convergence. Finally, applying our results to the estimation of treatment effects, we could relax the assumption that the assignment probabilities had to be bounded away from zero and one.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带有缺失标签的多变量函数期望的非参数估计，发现使用最近邻匹配可以在极弱的协变量支撑假设下达到通常的收敛速度，并引入了可迁移性度量来控制分布间的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有非参数估计方法通常假设协变量支撑集为紧致子集且密度有界，这限制了其应用范围；本文旨在放宽这些假设，并探索在更一般分布（如流形支撑、重尾分布）下的收敛性质。
AI.method: 采用最近邻匹配估计器，将传统假设替换为源分布和目标分布之间的条件，包括一个可迁移性度量，并证明该度量对获得好的收敛速度是必要的。
AI.result: 在最小协变量支撑假设下，通常的收敛速度仍可达到；可迁移性条件适用于流形支撑分布，并允许目标分布具有比源分布更重的尾部；若可迁移性不足，则任何估计器都无法获得好速率。
AI.conclusion: 该结果放宽了处理效应估计中分配概率需远离0和1的假设，表明可迁移性是影响估计效率的关键因素，为实际应用提供了更灵活的理论保证。

title: Tests for the mean of high-dimensional data
summary: We consider the problem of testing the mean of high-dimensional data when the dimension may grow without explicit rate restrictions relative to the sample size. The proposed procedure is based on the statistic V_n = n||Xn||^2, which avoids inversion of the covariance matrix and is therefore suitable for high-dimensional settings.We establish asymptotic distributional results for both fixed and increasing dimension by embedding the observations into the Hilbert space l2. Furthermore, we prove the asymptotic validity of a bootstrap approximation for the distribution of the test statistic. The resulting bootstrap test yields asymptotic level-a procedures without requiring sparsity assumptions or structural conditions on the covariance matrix. In all this, a new Central Limit Theorem in l2 is proving to be an extremely useful tool.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于统计量V_n=n||X_n||^2的高维数据均值检验方法，无需协方差矩阵求逆，适用于维度可任意增长的情景，并建立了渐近分布理论和自助法近似。
AI.motivation: 高维数据均值检验面临维度增长无限制的挑战，传统方法依赖协方差矩阵求逆，难以应用。
AI.method: 采用统计量V_n=n||X_n||^2，通过将观测嵌入希尔伯特空间l2，建立了固定维和增长维下的渐近分布，并证明了自助法近似的有效性，无需稀疏性或结构假设。
AI.result: 证明了新的l2中心极限定理作为核心工具，检验统计量渐近分布成立，自助法检验能实现渐近水平α控制。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种在高维数据中无需协方差结构假设的均值检验方法，推广了适用场景。

title: A general proof of integer R\'enyi QNEC
summary: The R\'enyi quantum null energy condition conjectures that the second null shape variation of the sandwiched R\'enyi divergence (SRD) of an excited state relative to the vacuum is non-negative in local Poincar\'e-invariant quantum field theory, giving a one-parameter generalization of the quantum null energy condition (QNEC). We prove R\'enyi QNEC for all integer R\'enyi parameters $n\geq 2$ for von Neumann algebras carrying a half-sided modular inclusion structure. The only assumption on the excited state is finiteness of its SRD relative to the vacuum. Concretely, for any $\sigma$-finite von Neumann algebra with such an inclusion, we prove log-convexity, under the associated null-translation semigroup, of the Kosaki $L^n$ norm of any normal positive functional with finite $L^n$ norm.

AI.tldr: 对于所有整数Rényi参数n≥2，证明了Rényi量子零能量条件在具有半侧模包含结构的von Neumann代数中成立。
AI.motivation: 推广量子零能量条件（QNEC）到Rényi散度，为量子场论中能量条件提供更一般的框架。
AI.method: 利用von Neumann代数的半侧模包含结构，证明正常正泛函的Kosaki L^n范数在零平移半群下的log凸性。
AI.result: Rényi QNEC在假设SRD有限的情况下对所有整数n≥2成立，推导出非负的第二零形状变化。
AI.conclusion: 该证明确认了Rényi QNEC在更广泛代数结构中的有效性，无需对激发态做额外假设。

title: Coherent States of Non-Null Torus Knots
summary: We construct coherent states for the quantized electromagnetic field that correspond to the classical non-null torus knot solutions of Maxwell's equations in vacuum. We derive the displacement operators from the general relation between classical fields and coherent state amplitudes and verify the defining properties of coherent states through direct computation. We determine the observables of the model: field expectation values, energy density, Poynting vector, helicity, photon number, quadrature uncertainties, and correlation functions, and calculate their expectation values in the knotted coherent states in terms of the integer parameters $(n,m,l,s)$ of the classical solutions. As an example, we particularize the construction in the case of the Hopfion coherent state. These results establish the quantum-classical correspondence for this type of vacuum topological electromagnetic systems.

AI.tldr: 构建了对应于经典非零纽结电磁场解的量子相干态，并验证了其性质。
AI.motivation: 建立真空拓扑电磁系统的量子-经典对应。
AI.method: 从经典场与相干态振幅的关系推导位移算符，直接计算验证相干态定义性质，确定可观测量并计算期待值。
AI.result: 得到以整数参数表示的场期待值、能量密度、能流矢量、螺旋度、光子数、正交不确定度和关联函数等，并以Hopfion相干态为例。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了此类真空拓扑电磁系统的量子-经典对应。

title: Crossover from subcritical to critical decay: random walk, self-avoiding walk, percolation
summary: The study of the Ornstein--Zernike decay of subcritical two-point functions in equilibrium statistical mechanics has a history going back over a century. Despite this, the crossover from Ornstein--Zernike decay to critical power-law decay has received scant attention in the literature. We prove a general theorem which, under appropriate hypotheses, identifies the asymptotic behaviour of the solution to an Ornstein--Zernike equation on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ as that of the Green function for Brownian motion with drift, multiplied by an anisotropic exponentially decaying factor. The theorem applies to a wide class of random walks, to nearest-neighbour self-avoiding walk in dimensions $d \ge 5$, and to nearest-neighbour percolation in dimensions $d \ge 15$. Wide-ranging consequences follow, including details of the crossover from Ornstein--Zernike to critical decay on the scale of the correlation length, and the fact that all finite-order correlation lengths are equivalent up to universal constants. The proof is based on a variational characterisation of the direction-dependent rate of exponential decay and a major extension of Hara's 2008 Gaussian Lemma to noncentred kernels.

AI.tldr: 证明了在适当假设下，Ornstein-Zernike方程的解渐近行为是带有各向异性指数衰减因子的布朗运动格林函数，适用于多种随机行走模型，揭示了从Ornstein-Zernike到临界衰减的交叉细节。
AI.motivation: Ornstein-Zernike衰减到临界幂律衰减的交叉在文献中很少受到关注，需要理论理解。
AI.method: 基于方向依赖指数衰减率的变分刻画，并扩展Hara2008高斯引理到非中心核。
AI.result: 定理适用于广泛随机行走、高维最近邻自回避行走和渗流，证明了有限阶相关长度等效（相差普适常数）。
AI.conclusion: 该定理揭示了相关长度尺度上从Ornstein-Zernike到临界衰减的交叉细节，以及相关长度的普适等价性。

title: Generalized Error Bounds in the Recovery of Solitary Wave Profiles
summary: We investigate the robustness of Constantin's explicit reconstruction formula for two-dimensional irrotational solitary water waves. This formula recovers the free-surface profile from the dynamic pressure trace at the bed and depends on both the wave speed and the undisturbed depth. We consider simultaneous perturbations in these three quantities and derive an $L^2$ error estimate for the reconstructed profile. The proof uses the hodograph transform, holomorphic extension arguments, and Paley--Wiener Fourier-decay estimates, yielding stability estimates with sublinear dependence on the perturbation size. We include numerical computations to illustrate the effects of specifically designed perturbations.

AI.tldr: 研究了Constantin显式重构公式对波速、水深和压力扰动的鲁棒性，给出了L2误差估计和数值验证。
AI.motivation: 评估公式在实际应用中参数不准确时的可靠性。
AI.method: 利用hodograph变换、全纯延拓和Paley-Wiener估计进行理论分析，并辅以数值计算。
AI.result: 推导出重构轮廓的L2误差估计，证明稳定性对扰动大小呈次线性依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该公式对同时扰动具有鲁棒性，数值实验验证了理论结果。

title: A Finite-State Gibbs Construction from a Recognition Cost
summary: On a finite outcome space, the canonical Gibbs distribution is usually obtained by maximizing Shannon entropy at fixed mean of an externally supplied energy functional. This paper studies the finite-state consequences of a ratio-cost construction instead: after adopting the normalized d'Alembert degree-two closure called the Recognition Composition Law (RCL), with unit log-curvature calibration at the reference ratio, the continuous nontrivial positive branch is $J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1=\cosh(\log x)-1$. Given the induced cost vector $X_\omega=J(r_\omega)$, multinomial counting and convex duality recover the finite-state Gibbs weights and the identity $F_{\mathrm{R}}(q)-F_{\mathrm{R}}(p)=T_{\mathrm{R}}\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q\Vert p)$; the entropy-maximization steps are classical once the cost is fixed. New technical content includes a non-asymptotic Stirling bound and soft-shell constrained-type theorems for real-valued costs. A three-state example compares the Gibbs law to squared-log, affinity-as-energy, and Tsallis alternatives at the same cost vector and mean-cost constraint, with sample-size power calculations at fixed RCL ground truth. The framework is conditional on axioms (A1)--(A3) and restricted to finite outcome spaces with strictly positive weights; it does not derive the composition law from a more primitive principle.
comment: 50 pages, 2 figures. Python scripts for numerical tables and figures included as ancillary files

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于比率成本构造的有限状态吉布斯分布，使用归一化达朗贝尔二次闭包识别组合律（RCL），得到连续正分支J(x)=cosh(log x)-1。通过多项计数和凸对偶恢复有限状态吉布斯权重和恒等式。包含非渐近Stirling界和软壳约束定理。三状态示例比较了吉布斯律与平方对数、亲和力能量和Tsallis替代方案。
AI.motivation: 在有限结果空间上，通常通过最大化给定能量泛函的香农熵获得吉布斯分布。本文研究使用比率成本构造（基于达朗贝尔二次闭包识别组合律RCL）的替代方案，并探讨其优势。
AI.method: 采用归一化达朗贝尔二次闭包识别组合律（RCL），以单位对数曲率校准参考比率，得到连续正分支J(x)=cosh(log x)-1。通过多项计数和凸对偶推导有限状态吉布斯权重及恒等式F_R(q)-F_R(p)=T_R D_KL(q||p)。
AI.result: 得到非渐近Stirling界和软壳约束型定理。在三状态示例中，比较了吉布斯律与平方对数、亲和力作为能量和Tsallis替代方案在相同成本向量和均值成本约束下的表现，并基于固定RCL真实值进行了样本量功效计算。
AI.conclusion: 该框架依赖于公理(A1)-(A3)，仅限于严格正权的有限结果空间，未从更基本的原则推导组合律。

title: Nonlocal Optical Response and Surface Susceptibilities: A Systematic Derivation via Spatial Moment Expansion
summary: We present a systematic theory connecting the nonlocal response kernel of a homogeneous medium to its effective surface susceptibilities for an arbitrary curved interface. Starting from the most general tensorial nonlocal constitutive relation and combining a spatial moment expansion with a distributional thin-layer limit, we show that the full complexity of the interfacial response condenses, at leading order, into a single scalar: the surface susceptibility $\chi^s$, equal for the tangential and normal components of the electric field. These quantities provide a constructive generalization of the Feibelman $d$-parameters to interfaces of arbitrary curvature, and the curvature corrections, proportional to the geometric invariants $H$ (mean curvature) and $K$ (Gaussian curvature), are derived explicitly. The formalism is illustrated on a comprehensive set of analytically tractable cases (planar, spherical, cylindrical, and ellipsoidal interfaces) for several kernel choices (Gaussian, Yukawa, tensorial Lorentz). Generalized Maxwell boundary conditions are established and compared with the classical Fresnel results.

AI.tldr: 提出将非局部响应核与任意弯曲界面有效表面敏感度相联系的系统理论，将界面响应凝聚为单一标量χ^s，并推广Feibelman d参数到任意曲率。
AI.motivation: 需要统一描述非局部介质中任意弯曲界面的电磁响应，超越传统平面界面参数的限制。
AI.method: 从一般张量非局部本构关系出发，结合空间矩展开和分布薄层极限，推导出表面敏感度标量及曲率修正项。
AI.result: 得到表面敏感度χ^s与几何不变量H、K的关系，并在平面、球面等界面和多种核函数下验证，建立广义麦克斯韦边界条件。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为任意曲率界面的非局部响应提供了统一框架，广义边界条件可替代经典Fresnel公式。

title: Turbulent stretching of FENE dumbbell polymer model via special stochastic scaling and singular limits
summary: We investigate the stretching mechanism of Finitely Extensible Nonlinear Elastic (FENE) model of polymers in a random turbulent flow. The turbulent model includes a dominant space-scale $\ell\sim N^{-1}$, a dominant time-scale $\tau$, and is white in time. Under suitable scaling assumption, the polymer density equation, initially a stochastic Fokker-Planck equation in the presence of transport-stretching noise, converges weakly as $N\uparrow \infty$ to a limit deterministic equation with a new extra term, a second order operator. This operator, whose shape has been predicted in the physical literature by other arguments, express a sort of average `turbulent stretching' effect. With respect to other derivation of this effective model, the main novelty of our approach is that the deterministic limit is obtained pathwise, without having to take averages with respect to different realizations of the random flow. Next, we consider the limit as $\tau \downarrow 0$ and we identify the stationary distribution of the polymer length. The analysis is carried out in appropriate weighted spaces, which take into account the singularity of the FENE force near the boundary and the no-flux boundary condition, and combines stochastic scaling limit and singular limit techniques.

AI.tldr: 研究FENE聚合物模型在随机湍流中的拉伸机制，通过随机缩放极限和奇异极限技术，得到了确定性极限方程并识别了平稳分布。
AI.motivation: 理解聚合物在湍流中的拉伸行为，尤其是平均湍流拉伸效应的数学描述。
AI.method: 采用随机Fokker-Planck方程，结合主导空间尺度和时间尺度的缩放假设，利用路径wise收敛和加权空间分析。
AI.result: 聚合物密度方程弱收敛到带有二阶算子的确定性方程，该算子代表平均湍流拉伸；在τ→0极限下，得到聚合物长度的平稳分布。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需对随机流实现取平均即可获得确定性极限的新方法，并成功识别了平稳分布。

title: Multicritical Scaling Limit of Shifted Schur Measure
summary: We investigate the multicritical scaling limit of the shifted Schur measures. Under an appropriate scaling limit and specific conditions on the continuous parameters, we explicitly determine the limit shape of strict partitions distributed according to the shifted Schur measure. We then show that, under a multicritical condition, the edge scaling limit of the correlation function converges to a determinant of the higher-order Airy kernel. This rigorously demonstrates a transition from a Pfaffian point process to a determinantal distribution in the scaling limit.

AI.tldr: 研究了移位Schur测度的多临界标度极限，证明在边缘极限中相关函数收敛到高阶Airy核的行列式，实现了从Pfaffian点过程到行列式分布的转变。
AI.motivation: 探索移位Schur测度在标度极限下的行为，特别是多临界条件下的相变。
AI.method: 通过适当标度极限和连续参数条件，确定极限形状；在多临界条件下分析相关函数的边缘标度极限。
AI.result: 位移Schur测度下的严格分拆极限形状被确定；相关函数收敛到高阶Airy核的行列式。
AI.conclusion: 严格证明了标度极限中从Pfaffian到行列式点过程的转变。

title: Quantum game theory for 2 2 games: a mathematical framework
summary: We develop a rigorous mathematical framework for quantum game theory applied to static 2x2 games, extending classical concepts to the quantum setting where players may employ arbitrary unitary operations (pure strategies) or probability measures over the continuous group SU(2) (mixed strategies). The Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein protocol is introduced as the standard implementation of quantum 2x2 games. We prove the existence of Nash equilibria for continuous quantum mixed strategies via a fixed-point argument, generalising the classical Nash theorem to the quantum case.

AI.tldr: 开发了量子博弈论在静态2x2博弈中的严格数学框架，证明了连续量子混合策略纳什均衡的存在性。
AI.motivation: 将经典博弈论扩展到量子设置，其中玩家可以使用任意酉操作（纯策略）或SU(2)群上的概率测度（混合策略），需要严格的数学基础。
AI.method: 引入Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein协议作为标准实现，通过不动点论证证明连续量子混合策略纳什均衡的存在性，推广了经典纳什定理。
AI.result: 证明了对于连续量子混合策略，纳什均衡总是存在的。
AI.conclusion: 提供了量子博弈论的严格数学基础，为量子策略下的博弈分析奠定了理论基础。

title: Fast convergence of Dynamic Capacities of GNS-Symmetric Quantum Channels
summary: We consider a quantum system described by a quantum channel $\Phi$ that is applied at every time step and study the time evolution of its information capacities. When $\Phi$ is a GNS-symmetric channel (this includes Pauli channels, for example), we give explicit exponential convergence bounds for the classical and quantum capacities. These bounds are in terms of entropic properties of $\Phi$. We further illustrate how these results help quantify the performance of active versus passive error-correction setups.

AI.tldr: 对GNS对称量子信道，给出了经典和量子容量的指数收敛界，并用于量化主动与被动纠错性能。
AI.motivation: 研究量子信道信息容量的时间演化。
AI.method: 考虑GNS对称信道（如Pauli信道），利用其熵性质推导指数收敛界。
AI.result: 给出了经典和量子容量的显式指数收敛界。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果有助于量化主动与被动纠错性能。

title: Nonlinear stability of continuously self-similar naked singularities for the Einstein-scalar field equations II: linearized stability
summary: This is the second part of a series of papers proving the nonlinear stability of a one-parameter family of continuous self-similar $C^{1,\alpha}$ naked singularity solutions, with $0<\alpha\ll1$, to the spherically symmetric Einstein-scalar field equations. These solutions were constructed by Christodoulou and are known to be unstable under sufficiently rough perturbations due to the blue-shift instability mechanism. In complete contrast to the previous instability results, we establish the linearized stability for those naked singularity spacetimes under perturbations of the same regularity as the background, revealing the central role of regularity in determining the strength of the blue-shift instability mechanism, and showing that it is not triggered at the regularity level of the background spacetime. The linear analysis carried out in this paper provides the foundation for the nonlinear stability result established in the companion paper [W. Zheng, Nonlinear stability of the continuous self-similar naked singularities for the Einstein-scalar field equations I: main results]. Together with that companion paper, this yields the nonlinear stability of these continuously self-similar naked singularities.

AI.tldr: 证明了相同正则性扰动下裸奇点解的线性稳定性，为非线性稳定性奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明裸奇点解在粗糙扰动下因蓝移不稳定机制而不稳定，但本文旨在探讨相同正则性扰动下的稳定性，揭示正则性对不稳定机制的关键影响。
AI.method: 对连续自相似裸奇点解进行线性扰动分析，考虑与背景相同正则性的扰动。
AI.result: 发现这些解在相同正则性扰动下是线性稳定的，蓝移不稳定机制未被触发。
AI.conclusion: 线性稳定性为非线性稳定性提供了基础，结合伴文证实了这些裸奇点解的非线性稳定性。

title: Non-combinatorial involutive braidings: the quantum algebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{k,m}$
summary: We investigate involutive, non-combinatorial solutions of the braid equation viewed as special deformations of the permutation map. By employing these solutions, we identify the associated quantum algebra, which we introduce as the $\mathfrak{gl}_{k,m}$ Yangian. The algebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{k,m}$ is also recognized as a subalgebra of the Yangian. Furthermore, we construct specific highest-weight modules of $\mathfrak{gl}_{k,m},$ which simultaneously yield the eigenstates of certain quantum spin-chain-like Hamiltonians. In the special case of the algebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{1,1}$ the spin chain Hamiltonian reduces to a variant of the Heisenberg XX model. Furthermore, we present a comprehensive analysis of combinatorial bases of highest weight representations of $\mathfrak{gl}_{1,1}$, explicitly linking them to specific shapes of Young tableaux.

AI.tldr: 研究辫子方程的对合非组合解，引入 gl_{k,m} Yangian 量子代数，构造其最高权模并关联自旋链哈密顿量，特殊情形下简化为 XX 模型，并分析了组合基与杨图的联系。
AI.motivation: 探索辫子方程中置换映射的特殊变形，并识别相关量子代数结构。
AI.method: 利用对合非组合解关联量子代数，构造 gl_{k,m} 的最高权模，并分析其组合基与杨图关系。
AI.result: 得到 gl_{k,m} Yangian 代数及其子代数结构，构造了最高权模，给出自旋链哈密顿量的本征态；gl_{1,1} 情形下哈密顿量退化为 Heisenberg XX 模型变体；建立了最高权表示组合基与杨图中具体形状的对应。
AI.conclusion: 成功将辫子方程解与量子代数、自旋链模型联系起来，并揭示了 gl_{1,1} 表示论与杨图组合学的明确关系。

title: Deconfinement For $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ Lattice Yang-Mills at Strong Coupling
summary: We make rigorous the physics prediction that lattice Yang-Mills theories with gauge groups which have trivial centers do not satisfy Wilson's criterion for quark confinement. Specifically we prove that $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ lattice Yang-Mills theory does not satisfy Wilson's criterion in a strong coupling regime.

AI.tldr: 我们严格证明了格点Yang-Mills理论中具有平凡中心的规范群不满足Wilson夸克禁闭判据，特别是SO(3)格点Yang-Mills理论在强耦合区域不满足该判据。
AI.motivation: 将物理学中关于具有平凡中心的规范群格点Yang-Mills理论不满足Wilson禁闭判据的预测严格化。
AI.method: 通过数学证明，具体论证了SO(3)格点Yang-Mills理论在强耦合区域不满足Wilson判据。
AI.result: SO(3)格点Yang-Mills理论在强耦合区域不满足Wilson判据。
AI.conclusion: 证实了具有平凡中心的规范群格点Yang-Mills理论不满足Wilson禁闭判据的物理预测。

title: Non-Invertible Symmetries in Compactified Supergravities
summary: We study the \textit{Kaluza--Klein} descent of non-invertible higher-form symmetry defects from eleven-dimensional Supergravity to Type IIA Supergravity. Starting from the eleven-dimensional construction of non-invertible Supergravity defects, we show that the full defect, including its auxiliary topological sector, admits a pushforward along the M-theory circle in the zero-mode Supergravity regime. The seven-dimensional \textit{Chern--Simons}-like auxiliary theory descends to a six-dimensional \(BF\)-type sector. We also show that the compactification of the eleven-dimensional \textit{Bianchi} sector splits into an invertible \(H_{[3]}\)-sector and a twisted non-invertible \(\widetilde F_{[4]}\)-sector, controlled by \(d\widetilde F_{[4]}+H_{[3]}\wedge F_{[2]}=0\). The resulting Type IIA defect algebra contains both an invertible Picard subgroup and non-invertible \(BF\)-dressed defects, with charged probes identified through the standard M-theory/Type IIA brane dictionary.

AI.tldr: 研究非可逆高形式对称性缺陷从十一维超引力到IIA型超引力的卡鲁扎-克莱因约化，展示了缺陷及其辅助拓扑部分在零模超引力下的推前，并得到IIA型缺陷代数。
AI.motivation: 理解非可逆对称性在紧化过程中的行为，以及从M理论到IIA型超引力的缺陷代数结构。
AI.method: 从十一维非可逆超引力缺陷构造出发，利用M理论圆的推前，在零模超引力区域内进行卡鲁扎-克莱因约化，并分析Bianchi扇区的分裂。
AI.result: 七维类Chern-Simons辅助理论约化为六维BF型扇区；十一维Bianchi扇区分裂为可逆H[3]扇区和扭曲非可逆F̃[4]扇区；得到的IIA型缺陷代数包含可逆Picard子群和非可逆BF修饰缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 通过标准M理论/IIA型膜字典识别带电探针，IIA型缺陷代数同时包含可逆和非可逆缺陷。

title: Discrete Mixed Quantization
summary: In this paper, we develop a mixed quantization technique for graph vector bundles and apply it to several asymptotic spectral problems, including the Alon-Boppana bound, the Kesten-McKay law, quantum ergodicity, zero divisor convergence, and Ramanujan vector bundles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于图向量丛的混合量化技术，并将其应用于多个渐近谱问题，包括Alon-Boppana界、Kesten-McKay律、量子遍历性、零因子收敛和Ramanujan向量丛。
AI.motivation: 图向量丛的渐近谱分析需要新的量化方法，以解决传统方法无法处理的复杂谱问题。
AI.method: 开发了一种混合量化技术，结合了图论和向量丛的量化方法。
AI.result: 成功将该技术应用于Alon-Boppana界、Kesten-McKay律、量子遍历性、零因子收敛和Ramanujan向量丛等谱问题，并得到了相关渐近结果。
AI.conclusion: 混合量化技术为图向量丛的谱分析提供了一种有效工具，能够处理多种渐近谱问题，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Non-minimal fluid Lagrangian couplings
summary: Gravitational models with non-minimal couplings involving functions of the matter Lagrangian and curvature have become popular in recent decades. By coupling the matter Lagrangian directly to the gravitational Lagrangian, one hopes to construct theories that can explain dark energy or dark matter without introducing additional sources. When this matter Lagrangian describes a perfect fluid, some technicalities are involved in its variational formulation. We present a careful derivation of the gravitational field equations together with the complete set of fluid equations. The fluid's equations allow us to define thermodynamic quantities such as temperature, chemical potential and number density and thus allow us to understand the effects of the non-minimal couplings on these quantities. We demonstrate the non-equivalence of the Lagrangian formulations of Schutz and Brown for these types of models and provide a detailed interpretation of our results.

AI.tldr: 本文仔细推导了非最小耦合引力模型中的引力场方程和完整流体方程组，定义了温度、化学势和数密度等热力学量，并证明了Schutz与Brown拉格朗日公式的不等价性。
AI.motivation: 非最小耦合引力模型旨在通过物质拉格朗日与曲率的耦合解释暗能量或暗物质，无需引入额外源项，但涉及完美流体的变分公式化存在技术细节。
AI.method: 对包含物质拉格朗日函数的非最小耦合引力理论，进行严格的变分推导，得到引力场方程和完整流体方程组。
AI.result: 得到非最小耦合下流体的热力学量（温度、化学势、数密度）定义，并揭示Schutz和Brown两种拉格朗日公式在该类模型中的不等价性。
AI.conclusion: 非最小耦合会影响流体热力学量，且拉格朗日公式的选择对理论表述有重要影响，需谨慎处理。

title: Nonlinear stability of continuously self-similar naked singularities for the Einstein-scalar field equations I: main results
summary: This is the first part of a series of papers proving the nonlinear stability of a one-parameter family of continuously self-similar $C^{1,\alpha}$ naked singularity solutions, with $0<\alpha\ll1$, to the spherically symmetric Einstein-scalar field equations. The stability holds for initial perturbations lying in a small open neighborhood of the data generating these naked singularity solutions, measured in a localized H\"older topology. These continuously self-similar naked singularity spacetimes were previously constructed by Christodoulou [D. Christodoulou, Examples of naked singularity formation in the gravitational collapse of a scalar field, Ann. of Math. 140 (1994), 607--653], who also proved their instability to black hole formation under sufficiently rough perturbations [D. Christodoulou, The instability of naked singularities in the gravitational collapse of a scalar field, Ann. of Math. 149 (1999), 183--217], thereby verifying weak cosmic censorship within a rough functional framework. In complete contrast, in this paper, we obtain the first nonlinear stability of these naked singularity spacetimes under general perturbations of the same regularity as the background. We rely on the linearized stability result established in the companion paper [J. Singh and W. Zheng, Nonlinear stability of continuously self-similar naked singularities for the Einstein--scalar field equations II: linearized stability]. Our result underscores the decisive role of the functional framework in formulating the Weak Cosmic Censorship conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明了一族连续自相似裸奇点解在球对称爱因斯坦-标量场方程中的非线性稳定性（在局部Hölder拓扑下），与先前在粗糙扰动下的不稳定性结果形成对比，凸显了函数框架对弱宇宙监督猜想的关键影响。
AI.motivation: Christodoulou曾构造了这些裸奇点解并证明其在粗糙扰动下不稳定，从而在粗糙框架下验证了弱宇宙监督猜想；但尚未有研究在同样正则性的一般扰动下检验其稳定性，而这对于理解泛函框架的作用至关重要。
AI.method: 基于伴生论文的线性化稳定性结果，在局部Hölder拓扑中考虑初始扰动的小开邻域，通过非线性分析建立稳定性。
AI.result: 在初始扰动足够小（按局部Hölder度量）的条件下，这些裸奇点解保持非线性稳定，不会转化为黑洞。
AI.conclusion: 弱宇宙监督猜想的有效性依赖于所选取的泛函框架：在粗糙扰动下裸奇点不稳定，但在足够光滑的扰动下却稳定，因此猜想表述必须明确函数空间。

title: Sampling pseudospectrum for data-driven matrices
summary: Many complex systems can be reduced to their key components through spectrally decomposing matrices that capture their dynamics. These matrices can in turn be constructed from data, often by least-squares fitting: examples of algorithms to do this include Dynamical Mode Decomposition and variants, subspace identification and eigenvalue realisation algorithms. Typical outputs of these algorithms include a range of isolated, peripheral eigenvalues capturing persistent emergent patterns in the system. However, there is no objective way to assess which of these discrete eigenvalues are artefacts of finite data error, and which are reflections of a fully sampled operator. n this paper, we present a sampling pseudospectrum $P(\lambda)$, that provides probabilistic information on the behaviour of finite-data eigenvalues in the complex plane, and an estimator $\hat P(\lambda)$, which can be obtained by reprocessing our finite data sample. The estimator, which is computationally efficient to implement, allows us to test statistically for the location of the true eigenvalues. This gives us a rigorous and very general way to assess whether the patterns we extract from finite data are likely to be signal or noise.

AI.tldr: 提出采样伪谱方法，用于统计检验有限数据中提取的特征值是否为真实模式而非噪声。
AI.motivation: 现有算法（如DMD）从有限数据中提取离散特征值，但无法客观区分哪些是真实模式，哪些是数据误差的假象。
AI.method: 定义采样伪谱 $P(\lambda)$ 并推导其估计量 $\hat P(\lambda)$，通过重处理有限数据样本实现计算，提供概率信息。
AI.result: 该方法计算高效，能统计检验真实特征值的位置，有效区分信号与噪声。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种严格且通用的方法，用于评估从有限数据中提取的模式是信号还是噪声。

title: Neural Point-Forms
summary: Point cloud learning often rests on the premise that observed samples are noisy traces of an underlying geometric object, such as a manifold embedded in a high-dimensional feature space. Yet much of this geometry is not captured directly by coordinates, pairwise distances, or learned graph neighborhoods alone. In the smooth setting, differential forms are devices to encode higher order tangency information. In this work, we introduce a new family of principled learnable geometric features for point clouds called neural point-forms (NPFs). In the absence of a natural tangency structure, we instead use Laplacian-based techniques from Diffusion Geometry to build a discrete model for comparing differential forms on point clouds via inner products. In the continuum, submanifolds of a shared ambient feature space are represented as comparison matrices, whose entries describe how pairs of feature forms interact with extrinsic tangency information. We make this intuition precise by proving the long-run consistency of comparison matrices under standard sampling, bandwidth, density, and manifold-hypothesis assumptions. This yields a compact, efficient and permutation-invariant neural layer whose output is a learned form-comparison matrix. Across synthetic and biologically relevant experiments, we show that NPFs provide a competitive, and interpretable representation, with the strongest benefits appearing when labels depend on sampling density, manifold-like structure, or response-relevant population geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出神经点形式（NPFs），一种利用扩散几何和拉普拉斯技术从点云学习微分形式比较矩阵的可解释几何特征方法。
AI.motivation: 现有点云学习基于流形假设，但坐标、距离或图邻域无法直接捕获高阶切向几何信息。
AI.method: 通过扩散几何的拉普拉斯离散化构建微分形式内积模型，引入比较矩阵描述特征形式与外在切向相互作用，并证明其长期一致性。
AI.result: 在合成和生物实验中NPFs表现竞争力强、可解释性好，尤其当标签依赖于采样密度、流形结构或群体几何时优势显著。
AI.conclusion: NPFs提供了一种紧凑、高效、置换不变的神经层，有效学习点云几何特征。

title: Complexity of Non-Log-Concave Sampling in Fisher Information
summary: We study the query complexity of obtaining a relative Fisher information guarantee for sampling from a log-smooth non-log-concave distribution; this is a sampling analog of finding an approximate stationary point in optimization. Our algorithm is based on the proximal sampler, which is an implicit discretization of the Langevin diffusion, and requires an implementation of the backward step known as the restricted Gaussian oracle (RGO). We show that by leveraging the recent results for log-concave sampling with high-accuracy guarantees in R\'enyi divergence, we can obtain an approximate RGO implementation that -- when used with the proximal sampler -- yields a complexity guarantee in relative Fisher information that inherits the same dimension dependence as log-concave sampling, and improves upon prior work for non-log-concave sampling. We also show a converse reduction that any improvement in the dimension dependence in relative Fisher information for non-log-concave sampling will yield an improved dimension dependence for high-accuracy log-concave sampling.

AI.tldr: 针对对数光滑非对数凹分布的采样问题，研究了获取相对Fisher信息保证的查询复杂度，提出了基于近端采样器和受限高斯Oracle的算法，并给出了复杂度保证及其与对数凹采样的维度依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 为采样问题建立类似于优化中找到近似驻点的保证，即相对Fisher信息保证，并探索其查询复杂度。
AI.method: 采用近端采样器（Langevin扩散的隐式离散化）结合受限高斯Oracle（RGO）实现后向步骤，并利用对数凹采样在高精度Rényi散度下的近期结果来近似实现RGO。
AI.result: 算法在相对Fisher信息上继承了与对数凹采样相同的维度依赖复杂度，并改进了非对数凹采样的先前工作；同时证明了逆归约：任何相对Fisher信息维度的改进都将转化为高精度对数凹采样的维度改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过近端采样器和RGO的结合，实现了非对数凹采样中相对Fisher信息保证的复杂度提升，并建立了与对数凹采样维度依赖的相互关联。

title: Testing properties of trees in graphical models with covariance queries
summary: We consider the problem of testing properties of graphs underlying high-dimensional graphical models. We adopt the model of covariance queries introduced by Lugosi, Truszkowski, Velona, and Zwiernik (2021). We study the case when the underlying graph is a tree. The main results of the paper show that, while reconstructing the entire tree may be costly, certain global structural properties can be tested efficiently. In particular, we design randomized tests for global structural properties that use a sub-quadratic number of queries. We develop testing procedures for several fundamental properties, including the number of leaves, the maximum degree, the typical distance, and the diameter of the tree. For each property, we obtain explicit query complexity bounds that depend on the target threshold and tolerance parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高维图形模型中树结构的全局性质测试问题，使用协方差查询，设计了亚二次查询数量的随机测试程序。
AI.motivation: 重构整个树代价高昂，需要高效测试全局结构性质如叶子数、最大度、典型距离和直径。
AI.method: 基于Lugosi等人提出的协方差查询模型，针对树结构，设计随机测试算法，查询次数为亚二次。
AI.result: 对每个性质获得明确的查询复杂度界限，依赖于目标阈值和容忍参数。
AI.conclusion: 树结构的某些全局性质可以在亚二次查询下高效测试，而无需完全重构。

title: Entropy Across the Bridge: Conditional-Marginal Discretization for Flow and Schr\"odinger Samplers
summary: For a fixed flow-based generative model under a small inference budget, sample quality can depend strongly on where the sampler spends its few function evaluations. Flow matching and Schr\"odinger bridges define probability paths, yet their inference grids are usually heuristic or inherited from one-endpoint diffusion. We derive a conditional-marginal entropy-rate objective for bridge-aware discretization, separating endpoint-conditioned bridge geometry from marginal flow evolution, and use it to build a training-free entropic inference-time scheduler from first principles. For Gaussian Brownian bridges this rate is closed-form and U-shaped, motivating boundary-heavy nonuniform grids. On trained two-dimensional bridge/flow models, the estimated profile recovers the predicted shape and improves 10-step ODE-Heun MMD over linear by 18.1%, with a paired 22.7% SDE-Heun improvement in the same low-NFE sweep. On EDM/CIFAR-10, the entropic time-discretization gives the best tested five-step FID (186.3 \pm 4.0 versus 200.5 \pm 2.9 for linear and 238.0 \pm 5.3 for cosine). On AlphaFlow protein generation, entropic conditional-marginal (cond-marg) scheduling shows advantage in low-NFE regimes on both CAMEO22 and ATLAS benchmarks. These results support entropy-rate scheduling as a practical low-budget allocation signal for high-dimensional bridge and flow samplers.

AI.tldr: 提出基于条件-边际熵率目标的桥感知离散化方法，实现免训练的推理时间调度器，在低评估次数下提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配和薛定谔桥模型的推理网格依赖启发式或继承自扩散方法，无法在有限函数评估次数下优化样本质量。
AI.method: 推导条件-边际熵率目标，分离端点条件桥几何与边际流演化，构建免训练调度器；对高斯布朗桥得到闭式U形曲线，指导非均匀网格设计。
AI.result: 在2D模型上，10步ODE-Heun MMD改善18.1%，SDE-Heun改善22.7%；在CIFAR-10上，5步FID达186.3±4.0，优于线性200.5±2.9和余弦238.0±5.3；在蛋白质生成上，低NFE区域在CAMEO22和ATLAS基准中表现优势。
AI.conclusion: 熵率调度作为低预算下的实用分配信号，适用于高维桥和流采样器。

title: Covert Bayesian Quickest Change Detection
summary: We investigate the problem of covert quickest change detection in a Bayesian and infinite-horizon setting. A legitimate entity seeks to detect a change in the state of a discrete memoryless channel as quickly as possible by actively probing it. Simultaneously, the entity must ensure its probing remains covert from an adversary monitoring the channel for active sensing. We introduce the expected covertness budget (ECB) as an analytically tractable covertness metric that bounds from above the relative entropy between the observation sequences induced by active and passive sensing. Under constraints on both the probability of false alarm (PFA) and the ECB, we establish a second-order asymptotic converse bound on the average detection delay as the PFA constraint approaches zero, for any positive ECB constraint, explicitly quantifying the maximum square-root-order covert sensing gain possible. Furthermore, we propose an achievability scheme utilizing a constant-sensing-probability Shiryaev-type policy and show that it matches the second-order asymptotic converse. We illustrate our result with a numerical example.
comment: 36 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE ITW 2026

AI.tldr: 研究了贝叶斯无限时间视野下的隐蔽快速变化检测问题，提出了预期隐蔽预算（ECB）作为度量，在虚警概率和ECB约束下建立了平均检测延迟的二阶渐近逆界，并设计了匹配的恒定探测概率策略。
AI.motivation: 在对手监视信道的场景下，合法实体需要快速检测信道状态变化，同时保持探测行为隐蔽，现有方法缺乏精确的量化分析。
AI.method: 引入ECB度量，约束主动与被动探测观测序列的相对熵；采用二阶渐近分析推导平均检测延迟的下界；提出恒定探测概率的Shiryaev型策略。
AI.result: 对于任意正ECB约束，当虚警概率趋近零时，获得了平均检测延迟的二阶渐近逆界，并证明了所提策略可达到该界，量化了最大平方根阶隐蔽感知增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过ECB度量和二阶渐近分析，首次严格量化了隐蔽快速变化检测的性能折中，所提策略理论上最优。

title: Breaking the Finite-Sample Barrier in Entropy Coupling
summary: Dependence among marginally constrained observations can break a finite-sample barrier. To formalize this phenomenon, we introduce the \emph{minimum list entropy coupling} $H(P\|Q_1,\dots,Q_m)$, the minimum conditional entropy $H(X|Y_1,\dots,Y_m)$ over all joint distributions with prescribed discrete marginals $X\sim P$ and $Y_i\sim Q_i$. Unlike classical formulations based on independent observations, our model allows $Y_1,\dots,Y_m$ to be arbitrarily dependent while keeping each marginal fixed. This enlarged coupling space reveals a sharp dichotomy: independent observations reduce residual uncertainty exponentially, whereas dependent observations can eliminate it exactly after finitely many samples. We characterize this zero-entropy regime through necessary and sufficient conditions and give concrete structural criteria under which it occurs. In particular, under mild support assumptions, zero entropy is achieved with $O(\log(1/P_{\min}))$ observations, where $P_{\min}$ is the minimum nonzero mass of $P$. We also develop a greedy algorithm with monotone approximation guarantees for computing $H(P\|Q_1,\dots,Q_m)$. Finally, we show that the same framework formalizes finite-sample limits in distribution-matching representation learning and randomness extraction, where zero entropy corresponds to exact recovery and exact extraction.

AI.tldr: 引入最小列表熵耦合，研究依赖观测如何打破有限样本障碍。依赖观测可精确消除不确定性，独立观测只能指数降低。给出了零熵区域的充要条件，并开发了贪心算法。
AI.motivation: 现有模型基于独立观测，无法捕捉依赖观测打破有限样本障碍的潜力。
AI.method: 允许观测任意依赖但固定边际，定义最小列表熵耦合；表征零熵条件；开发贪心算法。
AI.result: 依赖观测可在有限样本后实现零熵，独立观测仅指数降低；零熵在温和条件下只需O(log(1/P_min))个观测；贪心算法有单调逼近保证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架形式化了分布匹配表示学习和随机性提取中的有限样本极限，零熵对应精确恢复和精确提取。

title: DeepSlide: From Artifacts to Presentation Delivery
summary: Presentations are a primary medium for scholarly communication, yet most AI slide generators optimize the artifact (a visually plausible deck) while under-optimizing the delivery process (pacing, narrative, and presentation preparation). We present DeepSlide, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent system that supports preparing the full presentation process, from requirement elicitation and time-budgeted narrative planning, to evidence-grounded slide--script generation, attention augmentation, and rehearsal support. DeepSlide integrates (i) a controllable logical-chain planner with per-node time budgets, (ii) a lightweight content-tree retriever for grounding, (iii) Markov-style sequential rendering with style inheritance, and (iv) sandboxed execution with minimal repair to ensure renderability. We further introduce a dual-scoreboard benchmark that cleanly separates static artifact quality from dynamic delivery excellence. Across 20 domains and diverse audience profiles, DeepSlide matches strong baselines on artifact quality while consistently achieving larger gains on delivery metrics, improving narrative flow, pacing precision, and slide--script synergy with clearer attention guidance.

AI.tldr: DeepSlide是一个人在环的多智能体系统，优化演示文稿的交付过程（节奏、叙事和准备），而不仅仅是幻灯片本身。
AI.motivation: 现有AI幻灯片生成器主要优化视觉外观，忽视了交付过程如节奏、叙事和准备。
AI.method: 整合可控逻辑链规划器（含每节点时间预算）、轻量级内容树检索、马尔可夫式顺序渲染（风格继承）以及沙盒执行（最小化修复）。
AI.result: 在20个领域和多种受众中，幻灯片质量与强基线相当，但交付指标（叙事流、节奏精度、幻灯-脚本协同、注意力引导）显著提升。
AI.conclusion: DeepSlide有效支持完整的演示准备过程，超越静态幻灯片美学，提升了动态交付质量。

title: SDOF: Taming the Alignment Tax in Multi-Agent Orchestration with State-Constrained Dispatch
summary: Multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and CrewAI route tasks through graph-based pipelines but do not enforce the stage constraints that govern real business processes. We present SDOF, a framework that treats multi-agent execution as a constrained state machine. SDOF operates through two primary defensive layers, implemented by three components: (1) an Online-RLHF Specialized Intent Router trained via Generative Reward Modeling (GRPO) and (2) a StateAwareDispatcher with GoalStage finite-automaton checks and precondition/postcondition SkillRegistry validation for auditable execution control. On a recruitment system backed by the Beisen iTalent platform (6000+ enterprises), 185 expert-curated scenarios trigger 1671 live API calls. Our GSPO-aligned 7B Intent Router achieves higher joint accuracy than zero-shot GPT-4o on this FSM-constrained adversarial routing benchmark (80.9% versus 48.9%). In end-to-end execution, SDOF reaches 86.5% task completion (95% confidence interval 80.8 to 90.7) and blocks all 22 operations in the injection, illegal HR subset. Under a broader message-level blocking audit, SDOF attains precision 100% and recall 88%, expert agreement kappa=0.94. A separate evaluation on 960 SGD-derived dialogues spanning 8 service domains surfaces 201 stage-order conflicts under our FSM mapping, 41 of which arise in the normal split. This arXiv version reports the current validated scope; extended multi-seed training comparisons and deeper workflow evaluations will be released in a subsequent update.

AI.tldr: 提出SDOF框架，将多智能体执行视为受约束状态机，通过意图路由器和状态调度器实现防御，在招聘场景中达到86.5%任务完成率并阻止所有注入攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有编排框架如LangChain等未强制执行实际业务流程的阶段约束。
AI.method: SDOF包含两个防御层：在线RLHF意图路由器（经GRPO训练）和状态感知调度器，具有有限自动机检查和技能注册表验证。
AI.result: 7B意图路由器在FSM约束路由基准上准确率80.9%（vs GPT-4o 48.9%）；端到端任务完成率86.5%；消息级阻塞精度100%、召回88%，专家一致性kappa=0.94。
AI.conclusion: SDOF有效约束多智能体执行，防御注入非法HR操作，后续将发布扩展训练和工作流评估。

title: Does Theory of Mind Improvement Really Benefit Human-AI Interactions? Empirical Findings from Interactive Evaluations
summary: Improving the Theory of Mind (ToM) capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is crucial for effective social interactions between these AI models and humans. However, the existing benchmarks often measure ToM capability improvement through story-reading, multiple-choice questions from a third-person perspective, while ignoring the first-person, dynamic, and open-ended nature of human-AI (HAI) interactions. To directly examine how ToM improvement techniques benefit HAI interactions, we first proposed the new paradigm of interactive ToM evaluation with both perspective and metric shifts. Next, following the paradigm, we conducted a systematic study of four representative ToM enhancement techniques using both four real-world datasets and a user study, covering both goal-oriented tasks (e.g., coding, math) and experience-oriented tasks (e.g., counseling). Our findings reveal that improvements on static benchmarks do not always translate to better performance in dynamic HAI interactions. This paper offers critical insights into ToM evaluation, showing the necessity of interaction-based assessments in developing next-generation, socially aware LLMs for HAI symbiosis.

AI.tldr: 提出交互式ToM评估新范式，发现静态基准提升不等同于动态交互表现。
AI.motivation: 现有ToM评估忽略人机交互的第一人称动态开放性，需要直接检验ToM改进技术对交互的益处。
AI.method: 提出交互式ToM评估范式（视角和指标改变），系统研究四种代表性ToM增强技术，使用四个真实数据集和用户研究，覆盖目标导向和体验导向任务。
AI.result: 静态基准的提升并不能总是转化为动态交互中的更好表现。
AI.conclusion: 交互式评估对开发下一代社交感知LLM至关重要。

title: SkillSmith: Compiling Agent Skills into Boundary-Guided Runtime Interfaces
summary: Recently, skills have been widely adopted in large language model (LLM)-based agent systems across various domains. In existing frameworks, skills are typically injected into the agent reasoning loop as contextual guidance once matched to a runtime task, enabling specialized task-solving capabilities. We find that this execution paradigm introduces two major sources of redundancy: irrelevant context injection and repeated skill-specific reasoning and planning. To this end, we propose SkillSmith, a boundary-first compiler-runtime framework that compiles skill packages offline into minimal executable interfaces. By extracting fine-grained operational boundaries from skills, SkillSmith enables agents to dynamically access and execute only the relevant components at runtime, thereby minimizing unnecessary context injection and redundant reasoning overhead. In the evaluation on SkillsBench benchmark, SkillSmith reduces solve-stage token usage by 57.44%, thinking iterations by 42.99%, solve time by 50.57% (2.02x faster), and token-proportional monetary cost by 57.44% compared with using raw-skills. Moreover, compiled artifacts produced by a stronger model can be reused by a smaller or more efficient runtime model, improving task accuracy in cases where raw skill interpretation fails. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/AetherHeart-AI/Aeloon.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillSmith框架，通过边界优先的编译-运行时方法减少LLM Agent系统的冗余，提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有技能注入方式导致无关上下文和重复推理两种冗余。
AI.method: SkillSmith框架，离线编译技能包为最小可执行接口，运行时动态访问相关组件。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench上，token使用减少57.44%，思考迭代减少42.99%，时间减少50.57%，成本减少同比例。且强模型编译的成果可被弱模型重用，提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: SkillSmith有效减少冗余，提升效率，并支持模型间技能重用。

title: Fair outputs, Biased Internals: Causal Potency and Asymmetry of Latent Bias in LLMs for High-Stakes Decisions
summary: Instruction-tuned language models exhibit behavioural fairness in high-stakes decisions while retaining biased associations in their internal representations. However, whether these suppressed representations can affect model outputs - and whether such causal potency is symmetric across demographic groups - remains unknown. We investigate the use of open-weight models for mortgage underwriting using matched applications that differ only in racially-associated names and reveal a critical disconnect: models show no output-level bias, yet retain and amplify demographic representations across model layers. Through activation steering and novel cross-layer interventions, we demonstrate that this suppressed information is decision-relevant: when reinjected at critical layers, it produces near-complete decision reversals. Critically, this latent bias is asymmetric - steering interventions affect decisions in one demographic direction, while producing minimal effects in reverse - and susceptible to adversarial prompt engineering and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These findings demonstrate that behavioural audits focused on outputs are insufficient: fair outputs can mask exploitable internal biases. They also motivate dual-layer testing frameworks combining output evaluation with representational analysis for AI governance in high-stakes decisions.

AI.tldr: 指令微调模型在输出层面表现公平，但内部表示仍存在不对称的潜在偏见，可通过激活引导等手段逆转决策。
AI.motivation: 揭示指令微调模型在内部表示中保留的有偏信息是否会影响输出，以及这种因果效力是否对称。
AI.method: 使用开源权重模型进行抵押贷款承销实验，通过匹配种族相关姓名不同的申请，结合激活引导和跨层干预分析内部表示。
AI.result: 模型无输出偏见，但内部表示保留并放大人口统计信息；注入关键层可逆转决策；偏见不对称且易受对抗攻击。
AI.conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

title: CAX-Agent: A Lightweight Agent Harness for Reliable APDL Automation
summary: Large language models deployed for MAPDL finite-element simulation face practical reliability challenges: without structured execution control, tool encapsulation, and fault recovery, outputs may be inconsistent and task failures are common. The Agent Harness paradigm addresses this by inserting domain-specific orchestration middleware that manages tool lifecycles, workflow state, and recovery escalation. This paper presents the architecture of CAX-Agent, a lightweight agent harness purpose-built for MAPDL automation, and empirically evaluates one of its core components -- the recovery policy.CAX-Agent organizes execution into three layers -- LLM service, agent harness, and solver backend -- with a recovery ladder that escalates from deterministic rule patching through model-driven regeneration to context enrichment and human intervention. We evaluate three recovery strategies (no_recovery, rule_only, and model_only) on 50 standard structural benchmarks with three repeated runs per strategy (450 case-runs total). Two independent human raters score task completion under blind conditions; inter-rater agreement is strong (quadratic weighted Cohen's kappa = 0.84, 96 percent of score pairs within one point). Model_only achieves the best completion rate (0.9267), task score (3.59/4), total score (9.16/10), and zero-intervention rate (0.84), outperforming rule_only (0.7733, 3.17/4, 7.03/10, 0.00) and no_recovery (0.6933, 2.74/4, 5.60/10, 0.00) with large effect sizes (Cliff's delta = 0.81-0.87). The benchmark uses deliberately simple geometries to isolate recovery-policy effects; we discuss the scope of these findings and directions for broader validation.

AI.tldr: 提出CAX-Agent，一种用于MAPDL自动化的轻量级智能体框架，通过结构化编排和恢复策略提升LLM可靠性，实验表明模型驱动的恢复策略效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在MAPDL有限元仿真中面临输出不一致和任务失败的问题，需要结构化执行控制和故障恢复。
AI.method: 采用三层架构（LLM服务、智能体编排、求解器后端）和恢复阶梯（从规则修补到模型再生再到人工干预），评估了三种恢复策略。
AI.result: 模型驱动恢复策略完成率最高（0.9267），任务得分3.59/4，总分9.16/10，零干预率0.84，优于规则驱动和无恢复策略。
AI.conclusion: 模型驱动恢复效果显著，但基准测试使用简单几何形状，结论适用范围有限，需进一步验证。

title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
summary: Can AI systems discover genuinely new knowledge through iterative self improvement, and if so, at what cost? We introduce the NOVA framework, which models the common ``generate, verify, accumulate, retrain'' loop as an adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space. We identify sufficient conditions under which accumulated genuine knowledge eventually covers a finite domain, and show how their violations produce distinct failure modes: contamination, forgetting, exploration failure, and acceptance failure. We then analyze imperfect verification and identify a contamination trap: as easy-to-find knowledge is exhausted, the model mass assigned to new valid artifacts shrinks, so even small false-positive rates can cause invalid artifacts to enter the knowledge base faster than genuine discoveries. We clarify that Good--Turing estimation is a local batch-diversity diagnostic, not an estimator of the historically undiscovered valid mass that governs long-term discovery. Under a separate tail-equivalence assumption relating the model's effective discovery distribution to a Zipf law with exponent $\alpha>1$, we prove that the cumulative generation cost required to obtain $D$ distinct genuine discoveries satisfies $R_{\mathrm{cum}}(D)=\Theta(c_{\mathrm{gen}}D^\alpha)$, where $c_{\mathrm{gen}}$ is the per-candidate generation cost. This scaling law quantifies asymptotic diminishing returns as the discovery frontier advances. Finally, we formalize human amplification through guidance, generation, and verification, explaining why expert input is most valuable near autonomous exploration barriers.

AI.tldr: 提出NOVA框架，将AI自改进循环建模为知识空间的自适应采样，分析知识发现的充分条件、失败模式（污染、遗忘等）、污染陷阱，并推导出发现成本与数量的缩放律。
AI.motivation: 探索AI系统能否通过迭代自改进发现真正的新知识，并量化成本。
AI.method: 将“生成、验证、积累、重训练”循环建模为知识空间上的自适应采样过程，分析充分条件及其违反导致的失败模式，利用Good-Turing估计和Zipf律进行理论分析。
AI.result: 确定了知识覆盖的充分条件，识别了四种失败模式；发现污染陷阱：当易发现知识耗尽时，新有效知识质量下降，小假阳性率导致无效知识更快积累；证明在尾等价假设下，累计生成成本与发现数量满足R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α)。
AI.conclusion: 自改进AI系统能发现新知识但受缩放律限制，人工专家在自主探索障碍附近最具价值。

title: ICRL: Learning to Internalize Self-Critique with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language model-based agents make mistakes, yet critique can often guide the same model toward correct behavior. However, when critique is removed, the model may fail again on the same query, indicating that it has not internalized the critique's guidance into its underlying capability. Meanwhile, a frozen critic cannot improve its feedback quality over time, limiting the potential for iterative self-improvement. To address this, we propose learning to internalize self-critique with reinforcement learning(ICRL), a novel framework that jointly trains a solver and a critic from a shared backbone to convert critique-induced success into unassisted solver ability. The critic is rewarded based on the solver's subsequent performance gain, incentivizing actionable feedback. To address the distribution shift between critique-conditioned and critique-free behavior, ICRL introduces a distribution-calibration re-weighting ratio that selectively transfers critique-guided improvements compatible with the solver's own prompt distribution. Additionally, a role-wise group advantage estimation stabilizes joint optimization across the two roles. Together, these mechanisms ensure that the solver learns to improve itself without external critique, rather than becoming dependent on critique-conditioned behavior. We evaluate ICRL on diverse benchmarks spanning agentic and mathematical reasoning tasks, using Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B as backbones. Results show consistent improvements, with average gains of 6.4 points over GRPO on agentic tasks, and 7.0 points on mathematical reasoning. Notably, the learned 8B critic is comparable to 32B critics while using substantially fewer tokens. The code is available at https://github.com/brick-pid/ICRL.

AI.tldr: 提出ICRL框架，通过强化学习联合训练解算器和批评者，使解算器内化自我批评，无需外部批评即可自我改进，在代理和数学推理任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的代理依赖外部批评才能正确行为，移除批评后容易再次失败，且固定批评者无法提升反馈质量，限制自我改进能力。
AI.method: ICRL通过强化学习联合训练共享骨干的解算器和批评者，用分布校准重加权比处理分布偏移，用角色组优势估计稳定联合优化，使解算器学会不依赖外部批评的自我改进。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B上，代理任务平均提升6.4点，数学推理提升7.0点；8B批评者性能可与32B批评者媲美且使用更少令牌。
AI.conclusion: ICRL能有效将批评引导的改进转化为解算器自身能力，实现无需外部批评的持续自我改进。

title: NIMO Controller: a self-driving laboratory orchestrator based on the Model Context Protocol
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) have attracted increasing attention as a means of accelerating scientific discovery; however, developing SDL software remains technically demanding. To improve accessibility, orchestration software frameworks have been proposed to coordinate SDL components. Nevertheless, existing frameworks are primarily designed for human interaction and do not provide standardized interfaces suitable for AI agents. In this work, we propose an SDL software architecture based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), in which all SDL functionalities are exposed through MCP servers. Following this design principle, we introduce an MCP-based SDL orchestrator, named NIMO Controller. It provides a visual programming interface automatically generated through MCP-based tool discovery, allowing human users to design experimental workflows without writing code. The same MCP backend can also be accessed by AI agents, providing a unified interface for both human users and AI agents. We demonstrate the proposed system through a case study on a color-matching SDL. The results validate the usability of the proposed MCP-based SDL architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出基于MCP的SDl架构，通过NIMO控制器实现可视化编程，统一人类与AI代理接口。
AI.motivation: 现有SDl框架主要面向人类交互，缺乏适合AI代理的标准接口。
AI.method: 基于MCP设计SDl软件架构，所有功能通过MCP服务器暴露，开发NIMO控制器自动生成可视化编程接口。
AI.result: 通过颜色匹配SDl案例验证了系统可用性。
AI.conclusion: 基于MCP的SDl架构有效，为人类和AI提供统一接口。

title: Verifiable Agentic Infrastructure: Proof-Derived Authorization for Sovereign AI Systems
summary: Modern cloud and enterprise systems rely on identity-centric authorization, assuming that callers possessing valid credentials are safe to execute commands. The emergence of autonomous AI agents invalidates this assumption: agents can generate syntactically valid but semantically unsafe actions, making standing privileges a significant operational risk. This risk becomes especially acute in sovereign AI systems, where autonomous agents may interact with cloud infrastructure, regulated data, financial workflows, and national-scale digital services. Governed mutation substrates reduce this risk by interposing on agent actions: agents submit intents, infrastructure evaluates context and policy, and execution is mediated. However, this shifts the trust boundary: how can the decision to authorize an intent be made verifiable, distributed, and replayable? We introduce a Distributed Trust Framework (DTF), a verification framework for governed mutation systems that computes execution authority from structured, verifiable artifacts. DTF introduces a Justification Proof to encode the admissibility basis of an action, a consensus model for independent evaluation, an ephemeral Execution Identity derived from the approved proof, and an append-only Evidence Chain that preserves the authorization lifecycle. Under stated substrate assumptions, this architecture enforces a compact authorization invariant: no high-stakes execution without a proof object, no derived authority without consensus, and no valid mutation detached from evidence. We define the model, instantiate it over an OpenKedge-based governed mutation substrate, and show how it maps onto cloud-native environments. By shifting authorization from standing identity to proof-derived authority, DTF provides an infrastructure foundation for making agentic execution governable, auditable, and bounded in sovereign AI deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式信任框架(DTF)，通过证明和共识机制确保自主AI代理动作的可验证、可审计和可追溯。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理可生成语法正确但语义不安全的动作，使静态权限成为重大运营风险，尤其在主权AI系统中。
AI.method: DTF引入Justification Proof编码动作依据、共识模型进行独立评估、临时Execution Identity从已批准证明派生，以及仅追加的证据链保存授权生命周期。
AI.result: 该架构强制执行紧凑的授权不变性：无证明对象不执行高风险操作，无共识不派生权限，无证据不进行有效变更。
AI.conclusion: 将授权从静态身份转向证明派生权威，为自主AI部署中的可管理、可审计和有界执行提供基础设施基础。

title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with the rigorous reasoning demands of hard competitive programming. While recent multi-agent frameworks attempt to bridge this reliability gap, they remain fundamentally stateless: they rely on static retrieval and discard the valuable problem-solving and debugging experience gained from previous tasks. To address this, we present Solvita, an agentic evolution framework that enables continuous learning without requiring weight updates to the underlying LLM. Solvita reorganizes problem-solving into a closed-loop system of strategy selection, program synthesis, certified supervision, and targeted hacking, executed by four specialized agents: Planner, Solver, Oracle, and Hacker. Crucially, each agent is paired with a trainable, graph-structured knowledge network. As the system operates, outcome signals, such as pass/fail verdicts, test certification quality, and adversarial vulnerabilities discovered by the Hacker, are recast as reinforcement learning updates to these network weights. This allows the agents to dynamically route future queries based on past successes and failures, effectively accumulating transferable reasoning experience over time. Evaluated across CodeContests, APPS, AetherCode, and live Codeforces rounds, Solvita establishes a new state-of-the-art among code-generation agents, outperforming existing multi-agent pipelines and nearly doubling the accuracy of single-pass baselines.

AI.tldr: Solvita是一种面向大型语言模型的智能体演化框架，通过可训练的知识网络实现持续学习，在竞争编程任务中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型在硬竞争编程中推理可靠性不足，而多智能体框架依赖静态检索，缺乏从先前任务中积累经验的能力。
AI.method: Solvita将问题解决组织成闭环系统，包含规划者、求解者、预言者和黑客四个智能体，每个智能体配有可训练的图结构知识网络，通过强化学习利用结果信号更新网络权重，实现动态路由和推理经验积累。
AI.result: 在CodeContests、APPS、AetherCode和实时Codeforces评测中，Solvita超越了现有代码生成智能体，相比单次基线准确率几乎翻倍。
AI.conclusion: Solvita通过无需权重更新的持续学习机制，有效提升了竞争编程中的推理可靠性和性能。

title: SMCEvolve: Principled Scientific Discovery via Sequential Monte Carlo Evolution
summary: LLM-driven program evolution has emerged as a powerful tool for automated scientific discovery, yet existing frameworks offer no principled guide for designing their individual components and provide no guarantee that the search converges. We introduce SMCEvolve, which recasts program search as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and approximates it with a Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) sampler. From this view, three core mechanisms emerge as principled components: adaptive parent resampling, mixture of mutation with acceptance, and automatic convergence control. We further provide a finite-sample complexity analysis that bounds the LLM-call budget required to reach a target approximation error. Across math, algorithm efficiency, symbolic regression, and end-to-end ML research benchmarks, SMCEvolve surpasses state-of-the-art evolving systems while using fewer LLM calls under self-determined termination. The code is available at https://github.com/kongwanbianjinyu/SMCEvolve.

AI.tldr: SMCEvolve 是一种基于序贯蒙特卡洛采样的 LLM 驱动程序演化框架，通过理论指导的组件设计和收敛保证，在多个基准上以更少的 LLM 调用超越现有系统。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的程序演化框架缺乏组件设计的理论指导，且无法保证搜索过程收敛。
AI.method: 将程序搜索建模为从奖励倾斜目标分布中采样，使用序贯蒙特卡洛采样器近似，并引入自适应亲本重采样、混合变异接受机制和自动收敛控制三个核心组件，同时提供有限样本复杂度分析。
AI.result: 在数学、算法效率、符号回归和端到端机器学习研究基准上，SMCEvolve 以更少的 LLM 调用次数超越最先进的演化系统，并能自动决定终止条件。
AI.conclusion: SMCEvolve 提供了原则性的框架设计、收敛保证和有限样本复杂度界限，为 LLM 驱动的程序搜索提供了理论基础和实用工具。

title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning
summary: LLM-powered coding agents spend the majority of their token budget reading repository files, yet much of the retrieved code is irrelevant to the task at hand. Existing learned pruners compress this context with a single-objective sequence labeler, collapsing all facets of code relevance into one score and one transition matrix. We show that this formulation creates a modeling bottleneck: a single CRF transition prior must serve heterogeneous retention patterns, including contiguous semantic spans and sparse structural support lines. We propose LaMR (Latent Multi-Rubric), a structured pruning framework that decomposes code relevance into two interpretable quality dimensions, semantic evidence and dependency support, each modeled by a dedicated CRF with dimension-specific transition dynamics. A mixture-of-experts gating network dynamically weights the per-rubric emissions conditioned on the query, and a final CRF layer on the fused emissions produces the aggregate keep-or-prune decision. To supervise each dimension without additional annotation cost, we derive multi-rubric labels from the existing training corpus via AST-based program analysis, simultaneously denoising the teacher's binary labels. By effectively filtering distracting noise, LaMR frequently matches or even outperforms unpruned full-context baselines. Experiments on four benchmarks (SWE-Bench Verified, SWE-QA, LCC, LongCodeQA) show that LaMR wins 12 of 16 head-to-head multi-turn comparisons. It saves up to 31% more tokens on multi-turn agent tasks and improves Exact Match by up to +3.5 on single-turn tasks, while performance is frequently enhanced by denoising the context, and any remaining drops are marginal.

AI.tldr: 提出LaMR，一种多维度结构化剪枝框架，通过分解代码相关性为两个可解释维度来优化代码代理的上下文压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有剪枝方法使用单目标序列标注器，一个CRF转移先验必须服务于异质的保留模式，造成建模瓶颈。
AI.method: 将代码相关性分解为语义证据和依赖支持两个维度，每个维度用专用CRF建模，通过门控网络动态加权，最后用CRF层融合做出保留/剪枝决策；利用AST分析从现有语料生成多维度标签。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中，16个多轮对比赢12个，节省最多31% token，单轮任务EM提升最多3.5，性能提升或边际下降。
AI.conclusion: 有效过滤干扰噪声，经常匹配甚至超越未剪枝的完整上下文基线。

title: Zero-Shot Goal Recognition with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models have recently reached near-parity with classical planners on well-known planning domains, yet this competence relies on world-knowledge exploitation rather than genuine symbolic reasoning. Goal recognition is a complementary abductive task structurally better suited to LLM strengths: it consists of evaluating consistency with world knowledge rather than generating novel action sequences. This paper provides the first systematic zero-shot evaluation of frontier LLMs as goal recognisers on key classical PDDL benchmarks. Our results show that LLM competence on goal recognition is uneven: some models scale with evidence and approach landmark-based accuracy at full observations, while others remain anchored to world-knowledge priors regardless of how much evidence accumulates. Qualitative analysis of model reasoning traces reveals that this divergence reflects a fundamental difference in evidence integration rather than domain familiarity. These findings position goal recognition as a principled benchmark for the foundational planning knowledge of LLMs.
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 1 table; appendix with 8 figures and 2 code listings (29 pages total); submitted to NeurIPS 2026

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估前沿LLM作为经典PDDL规划基准中的目标识别器，发现其表现不均匀：部分模型能随证据积累提升准确率，部分则固守世界知识先验。
AI.motivation: LLM在规划任务中接近经典规划器，但依赖世界知识而非符号推理；目标识别作为溯因任务更适合LLM优势，需系统评估。
AI.method: 在经典PDDL基准上对前沿LLM进行零样本目标识别评估，分析推理轨迹以区分证据整合与领域熟悉度。
AI.result: 部分LLM随观测证据增加准确率接近基于地标的算法，其他模型表现与证据量无关，定性分析显示差异源于证据整合能力。
AI.conclusion: 目标识别可作为评估LLM基础规划知识的原则性基准。

title: Belief Engine: Configurable and Inspectable Stance Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to simulate deliberative interactions such as negotiation, conflict resolution, and multi-turn opinion exchange. Yet generated transcripts often do not reveal why an agent's stance changes: movement may reflect evidence uptake, anchoring, role drift, echoing, or changed prompt and retrieval context. We introduce the Belief Engine (BE), an auditable belief-update layer that treats "belief" as an evidential state over a proposition and exposes it as scalar stance. BE extracts arguments into structured memory and updates stance with a log-odds rule controlled by evidence uptake u and prior anchoring a. Across multiple base LLMs, parameter sweeps show that these controls reliably shape stance dynamics while preserving an evidence-level update trail. On DEBATE, a human deliberation dataset with pre/post opinions, BE best reconstructs participants whose final stance follows extracted evidence; stable and evidence-opposed cases instead point to anchoring or factors outside the extracted evidence stream. BE provides configurable infrastructure for studying evidence-grounded deliberation, where openness, commitment, convergence, and disagreement can be tied to explicit update assumptions rather than hidden prompt effects.

AI.tldr: 为LLM代理的信念更新提供可审计层，揭示辩论中立场变化的证据基础。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在模拟协商等互动时，立场变化的根源不透明（如是否因证据吸收、锚定等）。
AI.method: 信念引擎（BE）将信念表示为命题的证据状态，通过结构化记忆提取论点，并使用对数几率更新规则（由证据吸收率u和先验锚定a控制）调整立场。
AI.result: 在DEBATE数据集上，BE能最佳重构最终立场符合提取证据的参与者；稳定或反对证据的案例则指向锚定或证据流外的因素。
AI.conclusion: BE提供了可配置的基础设施，用于研究基于证据的 deliberation，使开放性、承诺、趋同和分歧可归因于明确的更新假设。

title: Ensemble Monitoring for AI Control: Diverse Signals Outweigh More Compute
summary: As AI systems are increasingly deployed in autonomous agentic settings at scale, it is important to ensure the actions they take are safe and aligned with user intent. Monitoring agent actions is a key safety mechanism, yet reliable monitors remain difficult to build and the scale of these systems makes human oversight impractical. We show that combining signals from diverse monitors into an ensemble improves detection of misaligned actions. We build 12 GPT-4.1-Mini monitors using both prompting and fine-tuning strategies. We evaluate them on coding tasks where candidate solutions pass standard tests but fail on adversarial inputs. In this setting, diverse ensembles outperform both individual monitors and homogeneous ensembles. Our best 3-monitor ensemble achieves 2.4x greater detection performance gain compared to an ensemble composed of three identical monitors, with the same ensemble performing strongly on an independent dataset. We contend that these results show that diversity - not scale - drives gains. The best ensembles combine strong individual performance with low correlation between monitors. Furthermore, fine-tuned monitors appear in every top-performing ensemble and maintain this advantage on out-of-distribution attack types, suggesting that fine-tuning enables detection capabilities that prompting alone does not elicit. These results support ensemble monitoring as a practical AI control strategy for safety gains at reasonable inference costs.

AI.tldr: 通过组合多种监控器（包括提示工程和微调）形成集成，能显著提升对AI代理不安全行为的检测能力，且监控器多样性比规模更重要。
AI.motivation: AI系统自主代理规模扩大后，保障行为安全至关重要，但人类监督不切实际，需要可靠的自动监控方法。
AI.method: 构建了12个基于GPT-4.1-Mini的监控器，采用提示工程和微调策略，在包含对抗性输入的编码任务上评估。
AI.result: 多样化集成优于单个或同质集成；最佳三监控器集成的检测性能比三个相同监控器集成提升2.4倍，且微调监控器在分布外攻击中仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 多样性而非规模驱动性能提升，集成监控是一种实用的AI安全控制策略，推理成本合理。

title: Beyond Partner Diversity: An Influence-Based Team Steering Framework for Zero-Shot Human-Machine Teaming
summary: While AI agents are rapidly advancing from isolated tools to interactive collaborators, data-driven human-machine teaming (HMT) methods remain costly in their reliance on human interaction data across domains, teammates, and team sizes. Zero-shot coordination (ZSC) addresses this bottleneck by simulating diverse partner populations to approximate how unseen partners might behave. However, partner coverage alone is insufficient as team settings scale and communication becomes degraded.
